h1: Homes for Sale in Sioux Falls
lead: South Dakota's largest city, with homes from historic downtown streets to brand-new subdivisions.
living:
Sioux Falls is South Dakota's largest city, with about 192,500 people at the 2020 Census. It sits in both Minnehaha and Lincoln counties, with the Big Sioux River curving through town and Falls Park right downtown.

Homes range from early-1900s houses near downtown and the Cathedral area, to 1960s–90s ranch and split-level homes in the middle of town, to new construction on every edge of the city.
know: What to know before you buy in Sioux Falls

• Two counties: the north and central parts of the city are in Minnehaha County, and much of the south side is in Lincoln County. Tax rates differ, so check the county on any listing.
  • Four school districts: most of the city is in the Sioux Falls School District, but some edges are in Harrisburg, Tea Area or Brandon Valley.
  • Getting around: I-29 runs along the west side, I-229 loops the south and east sides, and I-90 crosses the north.
  • Trails: the city's bike trail follows the Big Sioux River around much of town.
  • Owner-occupied status: if it's your main home, file for owner-occupied status to lower your property taxes. Here's how.
schools: Most of Sioux Falls is served by the Sioux Falls School District, but some edges of the city fall in neighboring districts such as Harrisburg, Tea Area, and Brandon Valley. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
faq:
What county is Sioux Falls in?

Both. The north and central parts of Sioux Falls are in Minnehaha County, and much of the south side is in Lincoln County. Tax rates differ, so check the county on any listing.

What school district serves Sioux Falls?

Most of Sioux Falls is in the Sioux Falls School District, but some edges of the city are in the Harrisburg, Tea Area or Brandon Valley districts. Always confirm the district for a specific address.

Can I get down payment help to buy in Sioux Falls?

Often, yes. South Dakota Housing programs, including Give Me Five, can be used for homes in Sioux Falls if you and the home qualify. Income and price limits apply. See the down payment help options.
